game.name: Getting Over It With Bennett Foddy
game.rules:
# Reminders

- Your Video must start before you reset.
- The End Screen that displays the time has to be shown.

If unsure about any of the rules or allowed mods, ask the moderators at [https://discord.gg/GpZwPy3](https://discord.gg/GpZwPy3).

# Gameplay Rules

### General

- Time begins upon completion of the loading screen (the screen is no longer fully black).
- Time ends when the credits are triggered.
- Deliberate glitches/warps that give an unfair advantage are not allowed.
- Runs must be completed without pausing or tabbing out. Runs on the mobile version can pause only when skipping credits.
- Restarting the timer by jumping into the water or any other method is not allowed.
- For individual Level (IL) runs savestates are allowed as long as they start in the previous segment or earlier and are not inside the splitbox.
    - Some of the default savestates in Anjo2’s modpack are not legal as they start inside the splitbox.
    - Savestates that automatically make the hammer launch off surfaces ([slingshots](https://clips.twitch.tv/VainAbrasiveMagpiePeoplesChamp-vc0K_bguBX6eALcU)) are prohibited.

### Mods

- Make sure the modpack text in the bottom right corner is visible.
- Gameplay altering mods are not allowed. Fast Start is the exception to this rule.
- Modpacks on the mobile version of the game are allowed as long as they follow the same standards as PC.
- These are the only mods currently allowed:
    - Any external or internal timer.
    - Fast start
    - Unobtrusive cosmetic mods that aren’t NSFW and don’t give an advantage. 
    - Multiplayer mod.

# Submission rules

### General

- If you submit a very high level time without any prior history, expect a verification of skill before your run is accepted. Generally this will be a livestream of your gameplay.
- Troll runs or runs over 1 hour will be rejected.
- No gameplay should be heavily obstructed (the player or any objects the player is interacting with.

### Video Requirements

- Video quality meets the following minimum criteria:
    - 360p, 24fps
    - No excessive stuttering or frame drops
    - Not too low quality to see the run clearly.
    - Recorded with a capture card or recording software such as OBS or Shadowplay.
- Video starts as a minimum when the loading screen is still black. Videos starting after the black loading screen will be rejected.
- The end screen must be open for long enough to easily read the time.
- Must be uploaded to a site that is both permanent and doesn’t require a download or account to view the video.
    - Recommended sites: YouTube, Bilibili.

### Speedrun.com Submission Rules/Guidelines

- Set yourself as player 1; do not submit other people’s runs on their behalf or as your own.
- Enter the run time exactly as it appears on the end screen. Do not manually time your run. Include Milliseconds.
- Copying the file directory from your PC will not let us view the run. Ensure the linked video follows the rules above.
- Set the date as when you got the run, not the date you are submitting it.

relatedGames.name: Getting Over It - Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
RULES MAY VARY BETWEEN CATEGORIES PLEASE CONSULT "Category Rules" FOR CATEGORY SPECIFIC RULES

Time will begin upon completion of the loading screen after starting a "New Game" or upon pressing Ctrl + R. Time will end upon the loading of the end screen. Endscreen must be shown long enough to tell what the final time is.

Videos must be uploaded onto a platform that is both permanent and does not require a download to view with the following specifications:

- Video source from either capture card or capturing software (OBS, Xsplit, Action, etc).

- Video resolution at least 360p and framerate is at least 24 FPS with no excessive stuttering or excessive frame drops at any point.

- The video is not too dark or too bright to see the run clearly.

Gameplay changing mods are NOT allowed for speedruns (apart from Fast Start). Cosmetic mods and multiplayer mod are allowed as long as they are non-intrusive. (for full list of allowed mods, see: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1etW1NArkM0mO1hZvQ7vGMvXiMNldnjgx57P1iCnwRck).

Glitches are NOT allowed for this speedrun. This includes the Barrel Glitch, Warp Glitches, the Hat teleporting glitch or Resetting Glitches. Any accidental glitches like bouncing or Hat Clipping may be allowed.

No gameplay should be heavily obstructed at any point (the cauldron, character & any walls and objects the hammer is interacting with).

Runs must be completed without pauses or quit-outs. Pausing on the mobile version is allowed only when skipping the credits.

Restarting the timer by jumping into the water at the beginning or any other method to reset the timer is not allowed.

If your first run is submitted as a top time with no prior history expect a verification of skill before your run will be considered for verification.

Runs near the top of the leaderboard require audio of the run. It is recommended to have audio anyway, and if your run is dubbed with music to have an un-dubbed version in the video or run's description.

Troll runs or runs over 1 hour will be rejected.

HOW THE RULES ARE INTERPRETED AND EMPLOYED ARE AT THE DISCRETION OF MODERATORS AND MAY BE MORE OR LESS LENIANT DEPENDING ON THE CIRCUMSTANCE.

If you are unclear about any of the rules mentioned, ask a moderator via the discord: https://discord.gg/GpZwPy3.
